parameters.content:
## Software factory
One run for each Linear ticket that gets the **factory** label:
ticket → plan → approval → (failing test ∥ workspace) → implement → verify → fresh critic → minimise → draft PR → Linear comment and a **factory_runs** row.

**Set up**
1. Import the three agents from `agents/` and publish them.
2. Fill in **Factory settings**.
3. Pick the agent on each Message an Agent node.
4. Choose the credentials on each node.
5. Publish this workflow.

**Today** the coding steps call MCP tools that do not exist yet, so a run stops at "Outcome: prep failed" before a PR. See the README.

## 1. Intake
Accept the ticket only when it gets the factory label. Stop when the critic is also an author or when the ticket has no acceptance criteria.

## 2. Plan and approval
A read-only planner writes a structured plan. A person approves it, asks for changes (loop) or rejects it.

## 3. Prep
The planner drafts a failing test. The coding_prepare tool prepares the workspace on the repository of the pull request. n8n runs the two branches one after the other.

## 4. Implement and verify
The implementer works in its coding session. A deterministic check runs the check command and the failing test. Only the first 3 checks of a run can get a retry.

## 5. Fresh critic
A different agent in a new session gets only the ticket, plan, diff and check result. Only an explicit approval continues. At most 2 repair rounds.

## 6. Minimise
Remove scope creep only, then check again. Each changed file and line must be in the change that the critic approved. The change must pass and stay inside the diff budget.

## 7. Draft PR
Push the minimised change, confirm the push and open a draft pull request. A person merges.

## Report
Every outcome writes a Linear comment and one row in the **factory_runs** data table.
